uncited: - Input: A set of candidate voxels (typically generated by a parent method like [Interior Voxelize](995-interior-voxelize.md)) and a volume mesh defined by tetrahedra.
**Calculate Normals:** For each triangle, calculate its normal vector.
**Plane Test:** For each of the four triangles, determine the side of the plane on which point $P$ lies.
If $P$ is outside any one of the four planes, it is outside the tetrahedron.
- **Time Complexity:** $O(V \cdot T)$ in the naive implementation where $V$ is the number of voxels and $T$ is the number of tetrahedra, as each voxel center may need to be tested against the mesh.
- **Memory Complexity:** $O(V)$ to store the voxel grid and $O(T)$ for the mesh data.
It is significantly slower than the initial solid voxelization pass.
